# emptea

> emptea studios is a small app studio in Switzerland making focused iPhone apps. Its first app is Crank, a workout tracker for strength training, available on the App Store.

## Crank

Crank (App Store name: "Crank: Gym & Workout Tracker") is a native iPhone workout tracker built for strength. iPhone only, iOS 26 or later.

- Log sets in seconds. 88 ready-made plans for gym, home and calisthenics (each at beginner, intermediate and advanced, 3 to 6 days a week), or build your own templates and folders. Crank remembers the weight and reps from last time.
- Nearly 400 exercises with step-by-step instructions, target muscles and your full history per lift. Custom exercises.
- Body map: front and back, 14 muscles, colored by what you trained. Tap a muscle for its strength standards.
- PRs and strength standards: every lift graded from beginner to elite (6 tiers) against worldwide data, with the gap to the next tier.
- Analytics: year heatmap, muscle balance, weekly volume, workouts per week, session length, bodyweight and steps. A streak that counts weeks, not days.
- Leaderboards (worldwide or by country) across workouts, time, volume, best session, strength, streak, exercises and steps. Head-to-head comparison with friends. Feed of shared workouts.
- Share cards for Instagram Stories and group chats. Strength Wrapped at the end of the year.
- Rest timer as a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Controls, Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight. Apple Health sync: weight and steps in, workouts out.
- 9 city themes with light and dark modes. 10 app icons. Available in 28 languages.
- Pricing: Crank Ultra is one plan with everything included. Eligible new subscribers start with a free trial, then a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757124183

## More from emptea

Two more apps are in development: FlexMax (flexibility) and Rise (a quieter mind). Details have not been announced.
